mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for four consecutive weekly means from -10.0 to -5.9, and this positive momentum carries into the next four weeks as reopening routines broaden, so the next 28-day mean exceeds the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: The next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean despite the four-week upward trend continuing at decision time.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -5.0, reduced travel friction allows more discretionary trips, and RETAIL_REC rises over the following two to four weeks as transit-supported footfall recovers.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -10.4 to -5.1 to -4.3 in the last three weekly means
failure_condition: After TRANSIT crosses above -5.0, the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean.
